G.S.R. 101.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, and in 
supersession of the Ministry of Agriculture, Department of Agriculture and Co-operation, Directorate of Economics 
and Statistics, Technical Assistant (Economics) Recruitment Rules, 2017, except as respects things done or omitted to 
be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of 
recruitment to the post of Technical Assistant (Economics) in the Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division in 
the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement.- (i) These rules may be called Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers 
Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division, Technical 
Assistant (Economics) Recruitment Rules, 2024. 


(ii) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification and Level in the Pay Matrix. — The number of post, its classification and 
the Level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. - The method of recruitment to the said post, age- 
limit, qualifications and other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule 
4. Disqualification.- No person - 

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 


(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for 
appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
such person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, and in consultation with the Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons.

G.S.R. 104.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution (Department of Consumer Affairs), 
National Test House, Director (Grade-II) Recruitment Rules, 2016, except as respects things done or omitted to be 
done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment 
for the post of Director in the National Test House, Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, 
Food and Public Distribution, namely :- 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and 
Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs, National Test House, Director, Group 'A' Post Recruitment 
Rules, 2026. 


(2). They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification, level in pay matrix.— The number of post, its classification, level in the pay 
matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, educational qualifications, etc. - The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
educational qualifications and other matters shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification.— No person, 

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 

Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to any person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 

5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary and expedient to do so, it 
may, by order and for the reasons to be recorded in writing in consultation with Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 

6. Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age—limit and other concessions required 


to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, ex—servicemen and other special categories of persons 
in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

G.S.R. 105.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of, - 


(i) the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Food and Public Distribution, 
National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, of Physical Chemistry Professor and Physical Chemist, (Group ‘A’, Gazetted Post) 
Recruitment Rules, 2017 in so far as they relate to the post of Physical Chemistry Professor; 


(ii) the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Professor (Agriculture Chemistry), Assistant Professor (Agriculture 
Chemistry) and Junior Scientific Officer (Agriculture Chemistry), Recruitment Rules, 2019, in so far as they relate to 
the posts of Professor (Agriculture Chemistry) and Assistant Professor (Agriculture Chemistry); 


(iii) the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Professor (Biochemistry), Assistant Professor (Biochemistry), Junior 
Scientific Officer (Biochemistry) and Research Assistant (Biochemistry) Recruitment Rules, 2019, in so far as they 
relate to the posts of Professor (Biochemistry) and Assistant Professor (Biochemistry); 


(iv) the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Professor (Organic chemistry), Assistant Professor (Organic chemistry), 
Junior Scientific Officer (Organic Chemistry) and Research Assistant (Organic chemistry) Recruitment Rules, 2019, 
in so far as they relate to the posts of Professor (Organic Chemistry) and Assistant Professor (Organic Chemistry); 
and 


(v) the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Assistant Professor (Physical Chemistry) Recruitment Rules, 2020, 


except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the 
following rules to regulate the method of recruitment to the posts of Professor (Chemistry) and Assistant Professor 
(Chemistry) in the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Department of Food and Public Distribution under the Ministry 
of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distributions, namely: - 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the National Sugar Institute, Kanpur, Professor 
(Chemistry) and Assistant Professor (Chemistry) Group ‘A’ Posts, Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Application. - These rules shall apply to the posts specified in column (1) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Number of posts, classification and Level in Pay Matrix. - The number of the said posts, their classification and 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the said Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.- The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the aforesaid Schedule. 


5. Disqualification. — No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said posts: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
such person from the operation of this rule. 


6. Power to relax. -Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, 
by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


7. Saving. -Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required to be 
provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, ex-servicemen and other special categories of persons in 
accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

O.N. 53.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Punjab, 2024, for 2- Amritsar Parliamentary 
Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/EPS/2024(7), 
dated 77 May, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 95, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 2- Amritsar Parliamentary Constituency of Punjab, 2024 was 
declared by the Returning Officer on 047 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 05.07.2024 of DEO, Amritsar under sub-rule (l) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, !96l received through the CEO, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2024/R-7458, dated 
22.07.2024 stating that Sh. Simranpreet Singh, a contesting candidate from 2- Amritsar Parliamentary Constituency 
of State of Punjab has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


34 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : MAY 23, 2026/JY AISHTHA 2, 948 [PART II—SEC. 3(iii)] 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 76/PB- 
LS/2/2024/CEMS-I, dated 2" August, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections 
Rules, 96l by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Simranpreet Singh, for not lodging of the account of 
Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 96, Sh. Simranpreet Singh was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Amritsar District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Amritsar has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Smt. 
Jashanpreet Kaur (W/o Sh. Simranpreet Singh) on 3.03.2026; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Amritsar in his Supplementary Report, received through the CEO, 
Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2026/R-4303, dated 2.05.2026 has reported that Sh. Simranpreet Singh has not 
submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, 
Sh. Simranpreet Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for 
failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section l0A of the Representation of the People Act, 95 provides that: - 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Simranpreet 
Singh has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to 
do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section l0A of the Representation of the People Act, 95, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Simranpreet Singh, resident of H.No. 4- Gali No. 4 Kapoor 
Nagar, Sultanwind Road, Amritsar and a contesting candidate from 2- Amritsar Parliamentary Constituency of 
State of Punjab, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or 
the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the 
date of this order.

सं. 10-5/2025-यू.3(ए)--जबकि, राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर द्वारा यूजीसी (सम विश्वविद्यालय संस्थान) 
विनियम, 2023 के अनुसार माता मनसा देवी कॉम्प्लेक्स, पंचकुला, हरियाणा में ऑफ-कैंपस शुरू करने के लिए यूजीसी पोर्टल पर एक ऑनलाइन 
आवेदन प्रस्तुत किया गया था। 


2. और जबकि, यूजीसी ने दिनांक 02.01.2025 के अपने पत्र संख्या 38-2/2024 (सीपीपी-आई/डीयू) के माध्यम से सूचित किया कि 
आवेदन की स्थायी समिति के माध्यम से जांच की गई थी। समिति ने संस्था की प्रस्तुति के बाद और प्रस्तुत किए गए दस्तावेजों के आधार पर कुछ 
शर्तों के साथ राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम-विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर को आशय पत्र (एलओआई) जारी करने की सिफारिश की। 


3. और आगे जबकि, मंत्रालय ने यूजीसी की सलाह पर माता मनसा देवी कॉम्प्लेक्स, पंचकूला, हरियाणा में ऑफ-कैंपस शुरू करने से 
पहले 3 वर्ष की अवधि के भीतर कुछ शर्तों को पूरा करने के लिए राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर को दिनांक 22.04.2025 
को आशय पत्र (एलओआई) जारी किया। 


4. और जबकि, कुलसचिव (कार्यवाहक), राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर ने दिनांक 07.10.2025 के 
पत्र संखया एफ.1(24)/एनआईए-पीके/आरईजी/एनआईए/2023-3890 के माध्यम से, एलओआई की शर्तों की पूर्ति के संबंध में अनुपालन रिपोर्ट 
प्रस्तुत की। इसे सत्यापन और आगे सलाह के लिए यूजीसी को भेजा गया था। इसके जवाब में, यूजीसी ने दिनांक 21.04.2026 के पत्र के माध्यम 
से सूचित किया कि अनुपालन रिपोर्ट को स्थायी समिति द्वारा स्वीकार कर लिया गया था और मामले में अंतिम अनुमोदन के लिए सिफारिश की 
गई थी। 


5. अब, इसलिए, यूजीसी अधिनियम, 1956 की धारा 3 के तहत प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, शिक्षा मंत्रालय, यूजीसी की सलाह 
पर, एतट्टारा राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम-विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर को माता मनसा देवी कॉम्प्लेक्स, पंचकुला, हरियाणा में एक ऑफ-कैंपस केंद्र 
शुरू करने के लिए अनुमोदन प्रदान करता है। 

6. राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम-विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर द्वारा इस मंत्रालय की पूर्व की अधिसूचनाओं में उल्लिखित अन्य सभी शर्तों के 
साथ-साथ समय-समय पर जारी विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग और अन्य सांविधिक परिषदों के नियमों/विनियमों का पालन करेगा।

New Delhi-01, the 12th May 2026 


No. 10-5/2025-U.3(A)—Whereas, an online application was submitted by National Institute of Ayurveda (Deemed to 
be University), Jaipur, on the UGC Portal for starting an off-campus at Mata Mansa Devi Complex, Panchkula, Haryana as per 
the UGC (Institutions deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2023. 


2. And whereas, UGC, vide its letter No. 38-2/2024 (CPP-I/DU) dated 02.01.2025, informed that the application was 
examined through its Standing Committee. The Committee, after presentation of the Institution and based on the documents 
submitted, recommended for issuance of Letter of Intent (1.01) to National Institute of Ayurveda (Deemed to be University), 
Jaipur with certain conditions. 


3. And further whereas, the Ministry, on the advice of UGC, issued Letter of Intent (Lol) dated 22.04.2025 to National 
Institute of Ayurveda (Deemed to be University), Jaipur for fulfilment of certain conditions within a period of 3 years before 
starting an off-campus at Mata Mansa Devi Complex, Panchkula, Haryana. 


4. And whereas, Registrar (i/c), National Institute of Ayurveda (Deemed to be University), Jaipur, vide letter 
No. F.1(24)/NIA-PK/Reg/NIA/2023-3890 dated 07.10.2025, submitted compliance report in respect of fulfilment of the 
conditions of the Lol. The same was forwarded to UGC for verification and further advice. In response, UGC, vide letter dated 
21.04.2026, informed that the compliance report was accepted by the Standing Committee and recommended for final approval 
in the matter. 


5. Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, the Ministry of 
Education, on the advice of UGC, hereby accords approval to National Institute of Ayurveda (Deemed to be University), Jaipur 
to start an off-campus Centre at Mata Mansa Devi Complex, Panchkula, Haryana. 


6. All other conditions mentioned in the earlier Notification(s) of this Ministry as well as the Rules / Regulations of 
UGC and other Statutory Councils, issued from time to time, shall continue to be adhered by National Institute of Ayurveda 
(Deemed to be University), Jaipur.

S.R.O. 18.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Armed Forces Medical Stores Depot Group ‘B’ Post (Senior Stores Superintendent) Recruitment 
Rules 2005; and the Ministry of Defence, Directorate General Armed Forces Medical Services, Armed Forces 
Medical Store Depot, Storekeeping Staff Group ‘C’ posts Recruitment Rules, 2006, in so far as they relate to the post 
of Store Superintendent, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President 
hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Senior Store Superintendent in 
the Directorate General Armed Forces Medical Services, Ministry of Defence, namely:- 


78 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA MAY 30, 2026/JY AISHTHA 9, 1948 [PART II—SEc. 4] 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Defence, Directorate General 
Armed Forces Medical Services, Senior Store Superintendent (Group ‘B’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 
(2) 11679 shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix. - The number of the said post, its classification and 
level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these 
rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.- The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. - No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Schedule Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and other 
special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this 
regard.

3. और जबकि, यूजीसी ने अपने दिनांक 02.03.2026 के पत्र संख्या 40-6/2025 (CPP-I/DU) माध्यम से सूचित किया कि यूजीसी

श्रीनिवासन कॉलेज ऑफ़ aed एंड साइंस फॉर विमेन, पेराम्बलुर, तमिलनाडु को सामान्य श्रेणी के अंतर्गत धनलक्ष्मी श्रीनिवासन इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ़

2. इसके द्वारा यह सूचित किया जाता है कि कम्पनी अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 248 (2) के तहत कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार को उपर्युक्त 


कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने 
का अनुरोध किया है।

No. LAFEAS-PS5001 1/1/2026/22-Perl Sec-RSS— In supersession of Notification No. RS/18/15/2014/06-Perl. dated 
27" January, 2023 and in terms of Section 4 of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and 
Redressal) Act, 2013, the Secretary-General, Rajya Sabha is pleased to reconstitute the ‘Internal Committee’ w.e.f. 6th May, 
2026, comprising the following members— 


1. Dr. (Smt.) Subhashree Panigrahi, Joint Secretary - Presiding Officer 
2 Shri Jayanta Kumar Mallick, Director - Member-Secretary 
3, Ms. Chitra Gouri, Director - Member 

4. Smt. Anuja Pethia, Advocate - Member 


2. The tenure of the committee shall be for a period of one year i.e., up to 5th May, 2027, or until further orders, 
whichever is earlier. 


3. The Committee would be responsible for providing protection against sexual harassment of women in the Rajya 
Sabha Secretariat and redressal of complaints of sexual harassment and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. 


4. The Committee will exercise the powers conferred in accordance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at 
Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, and perform the duties and responsibilities as assigned to it 
under the said Act or as assigned by the Rajya Sabha Secretariat from time to time. In terms of the said Act and Sexual 
Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Rules, 2013, certain compliances are also required 
to be observed by the Committee. The mandate and some key responsibilities of the Internal Committee, in line with the 
provisions of the aforesaid Act and Rules, are annexed to this Notification. 


SREEJA V., Director 


ANNEXURE 
Mandate and key responsibilities of the Internal Committee (IC) 


1. Receiving Complaints: The IC is responsible for receiving complaints of sexual harassment from employees. On 
receipt of the complaint, the Committee shall send one of the copies received from the aggrieved woman to the 
respondent within a period of seven working days. [Rule 7(2)] 


il. Conciliation Report: In case of settlement, the IC shall record and forward the report to the employer. Also copies 
of the report shall be provided to both the parties (Section 10 (2&3). 


iil. Inquiry Process: Conducting a fair and timely inquiry into the complaints received, which shall be completed within 
a period of 90 days. [Section 11(4)]. 


iv. Recommendations: Submitting findings and recommendations (including interim measures) of the inquiry to the 
employer for appropriate action. (Section 12). 


v. Submission of Inquiry Report: On completion of the inquiry, the IC shall submit a report of its findings to the 
employer within a period of ten days from the date of completion of the inquiry. [Section 13(1)] 
V1. Confidentiality: Maintaining strict confidentiality throughout the process. (Section 16 & 17). 
Vii. Annual Reports: To prepare Annual Reports in the manner as prescribed under Rule 14 and submit to the employer 


in each Calendar Year (Section 21).
